summary: This clinical study tests an experimental drug called orforglipron to see how well it helps adults with obesity or overweight lose body weight compared to a placebo. Participants will take a daily tablet or a look-alike inactive pill for about 18 months. The study focuses on people who have at least one weight-related health condition but do not have diabetes. Eli Lilly and Company is the sponsor for this Phase 3 trial, which aims to include 800 participants.
